Today I had one of the most heartbreaking experiences of my life. I arrived at this veterinary practice carrying my dog, who had suddenly become distressed while out on a walk. I was clearly panicked and desperately asking for help.
Before even taking my dog’s pulse or carrying out any examination, the female vet looked at my dog and said, “You don’t need a vet degree to see what’s wrong.” Those words, delivered before any assessment had taken place, were devastating to hear in that moment.
My dog had died, and while I understand that not every animal can be saved, what will stay with me is the complete lack of compassion shown during one of the worst moments of my life. I felt dismissed rather than supported, and the expression of disgust I perceived when I was desperately seeking help made an already traumatic situation even more painful.
I would never expect miracles, but I do expect empathy, professionalism, and basic kindness from someone entrusted with caring for animals and supporting their owners. Sadly, that was not the experience I received. I highly recommend you avoid this vet.

Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to see that your experience didn't meet your expectations.

We always aim to provide the highest standard of care and service, so we'd really appreciate the opportunity to understand what happened and see if we can help. Please feel free to contact the clinic directly at your convenience.

Kind regards,
The Village Vets Glanmire Team

We’ve been with Cashman Veterinary for over 5 years, following a recommendation from family and they have been brilliant from the start.

Gene is incredibly knowledgeable and always takes the time to explain the different options available. That said, the whole team is just as lovely; you get the same warm, professional welcome from everyone there. They really listen to you and never make you feel like you’re fussing over nothing. Most importantly, they treat our dog with genuine compassion, they clearly understand she’s a proper member of our family. 100% recommend them

I have been going to Cashman Vets for the last 6 years.   Village Vets have now joined with Cashman Vets.   They are absolutely brilliant.   The care they give Finn is unbelievable.   Jeanie and Sean  who are both Vets that I have dealt with have been absolutely fantastic.    Always very accomodating even in emergency situations.   I cannot recommend them enough.   Thank you.

I found a dog yesterday when i was going back from work. I catch the dog as I spotted broken leg when she try to run away. Once i catch her i went straight to hospital near me( and that was the worst decision i make). I offer help,that i gonna pay full bill and that i will find rescue to help to take care of the dog, as female dog hasnt got microchip( is that actually illegal in Ireland?!). Instead of that doctor( short brunette curly hair, around 35-40yrs) search on social media hunting groups does someone is looking for a dog( thats the explanation doctor gave me). A person without ownership took dog from hospital. Doctor didnt help at all. On her responsibility should be first help neglected dog and then search for owner. From the other hand cruelty of animals is under the law, and most of the wounds are not from week or two when dog was missing... in my opinion doctor should kept the dog and call guards or dog warden or anybody who could help. When i mention that to the doctor she freaked and kicked me out of the permisess. Someone who allowed people treating animals like that, shouldn’t call themselves a DOCTOR. Broken leg,ribs, issues with breathing(becouse of ribs) wounds all around body and paws...and she left “owner” to take such in need dog. Shame on You!
An extremely professional and super friendly Veterinary hospital in Glanmire.  So helpful to pet owners with any queries and always on hand to help with any issues.
Super nice doctor and staff. Clinic looks nice and clean. Big parking in front. Our pet was happy, so are we.
